news.summary: For as much as Magic: The Gathering has grown in popularity over the last several years, the market for proxie

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/07/10/ign-mtglobstercheflead-1752163435885.jpg

For as much as Magic: The Gathering has grown in popularity over the last several years, the market for proxies and counterfeits has also grown. And now, Wizards of the Coast is suing PrintMTG, alleging a counterfeiting ring for the trading card game.

Wizards of the Coast filed the lawsuit (via Aftermath ) in its home state of Washington, alleging PrintMTG "operate as a complex and sophisticated network (...) engaged in trademark infringement, counterfeiting and criminal copyright infringement on a grand scale." Wizards seeks $28.65 million in damages.

For the most part, PrintMTG was a destination for people to print proxies, or essentially fake Magic cards that could stand in for real ones, for either playtesting or trying before you buy the actual card. And, thanks to the Reserved list, there are plenty of cards that cost thousands of dollars for a legitimate copy, so it's easy to see why going to a website and spending $0.75 on a proxy version instead was a popular choice.

In its complaint, Wizards of the Coast seems to acknowledge the purpose that proxies serve, saying "an honest proxy is a stand-in for a real card that makes no claim to authenticity by appearance or otherwise. Though proxies are prohibited in all sanctioned Magic events, Wizards recognizes that private and noncommercial proxying is a vehicle players can use to further engage with the game, not to undermine it." But, it seems PrintMTG proxies were a bit too realistic.

Later on in the complaint, Wizards of the Coast describes what it sees as a legitimate proxy, which "include writing the name of a card in marker on a basic land card or on a blank card printed for this purpose, using one genuine card to represent another or sliding a slip of notebook paper into a card sleeve." PrintMTG and other proxy-printing websites like it, will instead print Magic's art on card stock, for a price.

Wizards of the Coast alleges that PrintMTG's proxies "directly harm Wizards by displacing sales of genuine cards" and damages "retail partners who sell those cards." But even beyond that, the company alleges that these counterfeits were "creating instability and uncertainty in the very secondary markets third-party retailers rely on as a revenue center."

There's a whole Reddit community that's sprung up, /r/RealOrNotTCG , where people post pictures of Magic cards to try and figure out if they're, well, real or not. However, PrintMTG is just one of many services that print realistic Magic proxies. This is a market that's been around for years, and it seems like Wizards of the Coast is finally cracking down on it.
This lawsuit comes after Wizards of the Coast recently changed the way booster packs work, and ahead of Darkhold Destiny, its third Marvel set.

news.summary: Strip Clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6, and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta-6-ign-1795542340689.jpg

Strip Clubs are part of the very DNA of GTA 6 , and exotic dance chain Spearmint Rhino is making the most of it, hiring a choreographer to recreate the moves of the in-game dancers for its patrons. According to the club, it's in response to a wave of requests from visitors and people sliding into its DMs.

"I’m fascinated with the attention to detail from Rockstar," said the head choreographer, Brooke Wilde. "I spent hours in Jack of Hearts and Delights Cabaret, mastering each performance to bring back to Spearmint, and now obsessed gamers can put down their controllers, get out of the bedroom, and experience their favourite virtual lap dances with the Spearmint Rhino girls in the real world. While the in-game strip clubs are addictive, nothing beats the real thing.”

While we can't be sure exactly how many people are reaching out to their local strip joints for IRL GTA-inspired bodily contact, you have to respect the hustle. It's also an interesting counterpoint given GTA 6's impact on another part of the adult entertainment industry, with Mashable reporting that Pornhub saw a 15.5% drop an hour after the game was released on November 19.

Spearmint Rhino's relationship with the series actually goes back to 2013 and GTA 5, when Rockstar used a play on the name of the clubs, Vanilla Rhino, and Rockstar has said that developers for GTA 6 visited strip clubs in Miami and Florida (where Spearmint Rhino has one of its venues) for research purposes.

In GTA 6, Jason and Lucia can both go to strip clubs either together as a couple or individually, and can opt-in for VIP lap dances. As explained in our GTA 6 sex and romance guide , you can throw money at dancers, and if you throw most of your money at one dancer they will remove some of their clothes.

“While gamers across the world immerse themselves in virtual worlds, demand for authentic real-world experiences has never been higher and we’ve had hundreds of inquiries from GTA 6 fans," explained the company president and COO, Kathy Vercher.

"Strip clubs are such an iconic feature in the franchise, and Spearmint Rhino is uniquely positioned to create a real-world experience for gamers. Thanks to the dedication of our Chief Choreographer, Brooke, we’ve been able to bring the in-game lap dance experience into our venues worldwide, with such accuracy that gamers are guaranteed to get a mindblowing real-life experience.”

news.title: Take-Two 严厉打击让游戏在 PC 上运行的非法行为，《GTA 6》重制版领导者退出
news.summary: The leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recreate GTA 6 on PC, have quit the project, althou

content.v: Just a day after Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek released the executable for the near-complete Xbox build of the game they dropped on Friday, at least two of the leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recompile it to run on PC, have called it quits—seemingly under pressure from Take-Two and Rockstar.

The release of the exe made the pirated Xbox build effectively complete, and that opened the door for recomp projects to do their thing—that is, to leverage AI to quickly whip up a version of the game that will run on PC. Some hackers estimated it could be done within a week; Shayder, one of the lead developers on the Leonida project, said on X that followers could "expect a lot of static recompilation work to be done soon."

In a separate message on the Leonida Discord, Shayder tempered expectations a bit, writing that "it will take at least a week" to come up with something playable on PC. During a subsequent livestream, however, the team was seemingly able to get the GTA 6 splash screen to come up on PC, although it crashed after that. It sure seemed like things were moving ahead quickly.

But then things began moving quickly in a different direction. "I quit guys. I’m sorry," NotRexed, apparently the head of the project, posted last night on X . "I really want to make cool stuff but every single time shit happens that I can’t control so I’m stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the discord that allowed me to have this opportunity."

Later, they added , "Last post from me. I wanna clear things up. Rockstar taking my server down was only part of the reason. Like I’ve said before, I’m a 15 year old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/s6VhP2q79EgtSq3d7AamJk-1920-80.png
In a reply post, NotRexed stated explicitly that "Rockstar shut the server down," and shared an image of the copyright violation notice he'd received from Discord.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2vMmWbeyPsdLfRRf5BVmMk-1920-80.png
Shayder, who had previously predicted rapid progress on the Leonida effort following the release of the Xbox executable, took a more direct approach and simply deleted all of their X posts.

This isn't necessarily the end of work to bring GTA 6 (in a probably not-great state) to PC via AI. Other such projects are underway, and there also appears to be an effort to carry on with Leonida: The website remains up, with a new name attached as owner, and there's at least one Discord server dedicated to it, although it appears a little less focused at this point than the original Leonida server. A new Github repository (NotRexed also deleted that) has been set up: It's "a continuation of NotRexed's Leonida project," according to a note on the project, which adds that "development continues here with its full commit history."

The advent of AI greatly simplifies and speeds up the work of bringing console games to PC (as long as you're not too picky about the quality), and that makes life tougher for companies that want to keep a lid on such projects. Still, it's not surprising that Take-Two and Rockstar are going hard on it: In the past, Take-Two has moved aggressively to shut down GTA 5 mod projects, an effort that culminated in its acquisition of the biggest and best of them . I've reached out to Take-Two for more information on the takedown and will update if I receive a reply.

content.v: POWER: BAG OF TOYS Hold the Ability Button to open the Bag of Toys and choose from 2 Toys . New Toys are randomly available each time the bag is opened. Closing the bag triggers a 10s cooldown.

SPECIAL ITEMS: TOYS Each Toy is single-use. Acid Bottle Hold Power Button to aim, then press Attack Button to throw an Acid Bottle which breaks on impact, creating an Acid Puddle that lasts for 1.5s. Inflicts Torture on injured Survivors. If a wall is hit with an Acid Bottle , a puddle will form at its base, so long as the impact point is below 8m.

Flamethrower Hold Power Button to ready, then press Attack Button to unleash a stream of Flames. Inflicts Torture on injured Survivors. Burning Flames ignite the environment for up to 6s, as well as Generators, Windows, and Downed Pallets for 6s.
Handgun Hold Power Button to aim, then press Attack Button to fire a single round. Inflicts Torture on injured Survivors.
Flail Hold Power Button to wield the Flail , then press Attack Button to strike. Inflicts Torture on injured Survivors.
5m range.
Strikes over Window vaults, Pallets, and short objects.

Bike Horn Hold Power Button to ready, then press Attack Button to squeeze the Bike Horn, detecting Survivors within a 6m radius and an unlimited forward range. A detected Survivor is revealed by a loud noise notification. If multiple Survivors are detected, they are afflicted with Oblivious and Killer Instinct reveals their locations. When a Tortured Survivor is detected, the duration of their affliction is reset. Unlike other Toys, the Bike Horn 's Deadliness increases when it detects multiple Survivors. At maximum Deadliness , detected Survivors who are repairing or healing have their interactions interrupted with an instant 5% regression to repair progress and 5% regression to healing progress.

Toys damage healthy Survivors and inflict injured Survivors with Torture . Hit a Tortured Survivor with a different Toy to down them. Inflicting Torture increases a Toy 's Deadliness by 1 point. At maximum Deadliness , a Toy both injures and inflicts Torture on a healthy Survivor and downs injured Survivors. However, the amount of points for all other Toys to reach maximum Deadliness increases by 1.
The Torture affliction lasts for 40s, or until the Survivor returns to a healthy state or is downed.

The duration of Torture is reset when hit by the same Toy . SPECIAL ACTION: TAUNT When a different Toy hits a Tortured Survivor, they are downed and afflicted with Terrified . Tap Ability Button within 6m of a Terrified Survivor in the dying state to Taunt them, increasing the Deadliness of all Toys by 1 point. This removes the Survivor’s Terrified state. Hooked Survivors will be automatically Taunted .

Gain Exhausted .
Gain Oblivious .
When they leave this range, the effect lingers for 3/4/5s .

When all remaining Survivors have 2 Hook States and all Generators are completed, you can kill Survivors.
While killing a Survivor, both Exit Gate Switches are blocked. Whenever you finish killing a Survivor, this ends after 12/16/20s .

news.title: 与三个月前相比，《巫师 4》的开发人员有所减少，但也只是勉强维持
news.summary: As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed new information about its projec

content.v: As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed new information about its projects and headcount.

For the quarter that ended on October 31, The Witcher 4 was the company's biggest project by headcount, with 513 people working on it. That's down from 519 people for the quarter that ended on July 31.

For comparison, the number of developers on Cyberpunk 2 rose from 184 to 199 and staffers on the new IP codenamed Hadar jumped from 33 to 34. The codename Sirius game, believed to be a multiplayer The Witcher game, saw its development staff shrink from 84 to 60; the project has undergone numerous shifts throughout its development as CD Projekt reworks the experience.
CD Projekt's total development headcount rose from 1,045 to 1,051.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Screenshot-2026-11-24-at-11.29.46-AM.png

In terms of money , CD Projekt reported Q3 revenue of 208 million PLN ($51 million USD) and net earnings of 109 million PLN ($26.8 million). CD Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31 million PLN ($7.6 million USD).

CD Projekt has a number of big projects in the works, including The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in 2027 and The Witcher 4 in 2028. Cyberpunk 2 is also on the way, but it doesn't have a release window yet. The company is also working on a game with Scopely , the mobile gaming giant owned by Saudi Arabia.
Cyberpunk 2 was in the news recently, as the game's creative director joked that the RPG is now canceled because GTA 6 is so good .

news.title: 注意力策略RPG sickos：四年前俘获我们心的《火焰纹章》风格游戏带着续作回归
news.summary: Symphonic.

content.v: Four years ago (oh my god) strategy RPG Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga rather impressed our reviewer Jon Bolding. He wrote that "novel tactical mechanics make this indie a contender for the best strategy RPG this year".

Well, buckle up, 2027, because Symphony of War 2 has broken cover with a promise to release next year, and it's coming courtesy of the strategy sommeliers at publisher Hooded Horse, which I take as a very good sign.

SOW2 looks set to continue the Fire-Emblem-ish framework of its predecessor, tasking you with recruiting a gaggle of heroes to wage war with (and possibly compose symphonies, who's to say?) in "a world filled with political intrigue, betrayal, and tense, large-scale tactical battles". Which is a lot like our world, really.

It all looks very nice indeed. In the announcement trailer, we get glimpses of its squad-based combat and anime cutscenes, and I am officially into both. The art is poppy and distinctive, at some point an age-of-sail warship transforms into some kind of German WW1 destroyer, and the overworld triggers the regions in my brain devoted to thinking about Heroes of Might and Magic. Check, check, and check.

"Anime cutscenes!?" I hear you cry. "That sounds like the kind of thing that bespeaks a dense tapestry of lore I'll need to get to grips with first!" Well, apparently not. I am informed by Symphony of War 2's Steam page that the devs have no expectation you know what a "Nephilim Saga" even is before you pick this game up. "Symphony of War 2 is a standalone experience set several generations after the events of the first game—it can be enjoyed without having played Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga". The game's tale of a fallen empire trying to un-fall can be enjoyed single-serve .

news.title: GTA 6 之所以伟大，是因为其中所有凶残的 NPC，而不是无视他们
news.summary: Nobody wants to work for their crimes anymore, smh.

content.v: It's come to my attention that some of us aren't having a very fun time with the NPCs in Grand Theft Auto 6 . I've seen videos and threads of players complaining about not being able to steal cars because of crack head drivers , getting hunted down by killer NPCs , and just generally having a harder time traversing Leonida because who knows what bloodthirsty beast hides behind each corner? And to this I say, your steak is too buttery? Your lobster too juicy?

My first interaction with one of the unfriendly residents of Leonida started when I accidentally bumped into their car. Because I am wholly unaware of my surroundings, I didn't even notice that anyone was mad at me as I listened to my pop songs and carried on driving towards my mission. Little did I know that right behind me was a four-wheeler with a driver who had steam coming out of her ears.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FHpHsCT6pgzsfWhK6a7ou7-1920-80.png

So I pull up to the side of the road, ready to head in and start my mission, when seemingly out of nowhere the four-wheeler comes barreling in, almost taking me out completely. The driver gets out and starts screaming about payback. I have no idea what I've done, but this is GTA 6, I'm not taking this slander. So I start swinging.

The fight ends with me knocking this lady out, but she doesn't go down without a fight. At one point, I actually thought that was it for me—taken out on the pavement by a soccer mum, what a way to go.
But even if I had taken a long sleep on the sidewalk, that would've been OK, because it's all part of the beautiful package that GTA 6 offers.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QamfnYwDrXhvrAsUare8DD-1920-80.jpg

I don't want vapid NPCs that buckle at the first sight of a handgun, or have the object permanence of a goldfish. Filling Leonida with some actually competent, and dare I say dangerous NPCs makes this game infinitely more interesting. I like not knowing how one small action will ruin my whole day, or having to be a little wary of the people around me lest I want to incur a murderous chase across the city streets.
Terrorising helpless NPCs is fun, but only for a short while.

I have a theory as to why players are pushing back against aggressive NPCs: they just don't like having to put in the effort after years of being able to do whatever they want in GTA Online. There's certainly some that will look back on the mostly timid NPCs of Los Santos and miss when all they had to do to steal a car was swing open its door and throw the limp driver out. Aside from shouting, there wasn't really anything a regular NPC could do to pose a threat to you back then.

Rockstar amped up the mayhem and carnage you could cause, turning it into a chaotic playground with few repercussions. GTA Online players have become accustomed to walking around like some vengeful god, wreaking havoc wherever or whenever they see fit, and only very occasionally dealing out mercy. Now these fickle deities have been forced to become human again.
A part of me understands the appeal. Terrorising helpless NPCs is fun, but only for a short while. NPCs that actually have a backbone offer an experience that will keep me interested for far longer.
Plus, Leonida is based on Florida, do you honestly think you could terrorise the streets of Miami or Tampa Bay and walk out completely unscathed? Yeah, I thought as much.

news.title: GTA 6 给 Pornhub 带来了困难
news.summary: Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen

content.v: Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the "biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4 hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a quick browse of after-hours material.

According to Mashable , US traffic on Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically, Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later.

Thanks to the game's massive success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low.

Thursday Night Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the box office , as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120 million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

For more GTA 6 news, you can read up on how modders are attempting to make an unofficial PC port , how to fix GTA 6's broken HDR , and you can check out our list of walkthroughs in the GTA 6 guides hub .

news.title: 所有 GTA 6 Kitty Litter 实验室地点
news.summary: Take Out Kitty Litter for Tyrone across the Vice City.

content.v: Taking Out Kitty Litter's lab locations in GTA 6 is a mission in Tyrone's questline, and sees you searching the city for 18 secret labs (after the first one he directs you to). Every lab has a red smoking chimney and a blue and white Spin On This laundry van parked outside.

It'll take a little while, but it's well worth it to get the unique gold SMG at the end. Plus, Tyrone will start buying narcotics from you for the highest price possible. To destroy each lab, simply shoot a smoking pink flask and then run away. I've also laid these out in the most optimal order , separated into regions, so you're not driving back and forth across Vice City.
Last note: if you want to unlock map markers for the labs yourself versus relying on these videos, you can threaten cooks in certain labs to potentially reveal them.
La Perle labs
The first lab in La Perle trailer park

After you complete some missions for Tyrone (when you meet him with Dre'Quan during Dealer's Choice ) he'll direct you to this trailer park in La Perle where you destroy the first Kitty Litter lab and start the hunt for the others. You can see the route to the lab in the video above.
In the trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop

You can find this one in the trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop Ammu-Nation in La Perle. As soon as you go through the main gate, you can see the trailer with the funnel chimney where they're cooking straight ahead. Sneak around the back and break inside to find the lab. Or take out the three guys in front and go in that way.
Decor District labs
In the car park of Williams + Whitaker Homeware and Decor

Just across the road from the Mezzasega Espresso and Slinger in the Decor District. Pull off to the right of the road into the Williams + Whitaker Homeware and Decor car park. You'll see a garage with a shutter at the far end with a smoking chimney and the laundry van parked. Open the shutter to find a lone guy in the lab.
Rockridge labs
Across the road from Blessed Food Market

This one is behind Peterson's Autoshop in Rockridge, directly south across the road from the Blessed Food Market, under the overpass, on the border between Rockridge and La Perle. Head through the main yard and turn left to spot the laundry van. Break into it, move it forward, and open the shutter behind to find the lab.
Next door to Xero Gas - Rockridge

Just east of Fleeca Field stadium, next door to Xero Gas - Rockridge. You'll spot the blue and white laundry van parked off to the side of the road behind a wall. Head down that alley and turn right to find a garage door you can open with the lab inside.
South of Vice City Hospital

On the east side of the condominium building directly south of the Vice City Hospital, by Emilio's Auto Center Gas. Look for the closed road with the laundry van parked at the southern end and some staircases and flats off to the side with the chimney spewing smoke. The lab is through the white door on the bottom floor.
Near Bump and Grind Coffee

Just down the road to the west of Bump and Grind coffee and Salon Belle, in a block of flats southeast of Fleeca Fields stadium. You can see the laundry van parked outside. The lab is on the upper floor on the left side in apartment 5, where you can see the smoking chimney. Break in via the front door to find the lab.
Crosstown labs
Behind Cross My Heart Tattoos

This lab is an easy one to find, around the back of Cross My Heart Tattoos. Head around the right side, turn left, and look to your left for the garage door with the guy sitting down guarding it, with the lab inside.
Southeast of the Jack of Hearts

This lab is in the block of flats to the southeast of the Jack of Hearts and Urban Legendz, with the laundry van parked out front. Look inside apartment 103 on the first floor on the left side. It's quite hard to get away from this lab blowing up, so shoot it from outside and run away. Also this will likely cause a big shootout in the block, so book it.
Southwest of your apartment

This lab is to the southwest of your apartment in Chapter 3 and to the east of the Crosstown Mule - City Line marker. Look for an overgrown lot with the laundry van parked in it. The garage with the lab is just behind that.
South of Rideout Customs

This lab is directly west of Down Town Pawn, just between Rideout Customs and the Vargo's Gas station. Just past the gas station, look to the left where its fuel sign is to spot a laundry van, and further down the track, the garage with the lab and smoking chimney above it.
Tequesta labs
West of Vice Seven Condominiums gym

This lab is close to Xero Gas - Tequesta and west of Vice Seven Condominiums gym. When driving east to west past the station, turn right and keep an eye on your right towards the two floored condominiums for the laundry van parked outside. You want the set of staircases to the right of the van. Take the right side one up to the first floor to find the lab door directly ahead.
VCIA labs
East from Arrow Gas - VCIA

This lab is in a trailer park directly east down the road from Arrow Gas - VCIA, also west under the bridge from Pawn City and Vice City Firearms. Turn into the trailer park, take the first right and drive a little way around the corner to spot the trailer with the smoking chimney on the left. You can enter via a window around the other side to find the lab.
Salton labs
At the southern tip of Salton

This lab is located in the far south of Salton, north of the Pay 'N' Spray - Salton, next door to the Slator Towing Inc robbery. Go around the south side of the derelict block of flats and climb the dumpster to jump up through the open window to find the lab.
West from Xero Gas - Salton

This lab is west down the road from Xero Gas - Salton. Cross the train tracks, then keep an eye on your right for a carpark with a blue and white laundry van, then turn right into it to spot the building with the smoking chimney on the right. Hop the fence straight ahead and turn right to find one guy guarding the garage with the lab.
Little Cuba labs
South of Salon Perez

This lab is easy to find, directly south of Salon Perez and Safia Restaurant in Little Cuba. Look for some bungalows on the left with the laundry van parked outside. It's in the building with the chimney to the left of the one the van is parked in front of. The lab is the second door along.
Balasero labs
North of Pay 'N' Spray - Balasero

This lab is north up the road from the Pay 'N' Spray - Balsero. Turn left down the alley with the laundry van parked to find a guy guarding the gate, a couple of guys inside, and the lab in an open garage further back behind them.
Southeast of the Balasero jewelry stores

This lab is in a trailer park southeast from the Balasero jewelry stores, across the river. If driving from the east and the city, turn left before the bridge, turn right, then turn left and head a little way down to spot the trailer with the funnel chimney and laundry van outside. Sneak around back to get in and find the lab.
South from Ron's Car Wash and Gas

This lab is south across the river from Ron's Car Wash and Gas. Head over the bridge, across the junction, then keep an eye out to your left to spot where the laundry van is parked. The lab is just in the building beyond the gate with the smoking chimney. The door requires a code which is 1999 (referencing the billboard up to the right).

news.title: 劳拉·贝利表示，《最后生还者 2》的泄密加剧了强烈反对
news.summary: Abby actor Laura Bailey reflects on how pre-release leaks and online misinformation made The Last of Us Part 2

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/22/the-last-of-us-part-2-multiplayer-1782160463542.png
The Last of Us Part 2 actress Laura Bailey has reflected on how the game's pre-release leaks and the subsequent spread of misinformation made its ensuing online backlash much worse.

More than six years after The Last of Us Part 2 leaks ignited controversy online and sparked a wave of death threats towards Bailey and her family, the prolific video game voice actress has now labelled Naughty Dog's highly-anticipated sequel as being "cursed" from the off.

While acknowledging that the game's bold narrative choices would always have been polarizing, Bailey blamed the level of vitriol directed specifically at her on the leaks of specific scenes involving her character Abby that spoiled major plot points — and did so without the game's intended narrative context. Because of this, she believes, online outrage had already hardened across social media long before launch day.
Warning! If you're still worried about The Last of Us Part 2 spoilers, now's a good time to head elsewhere.

"That game got cursed by so many different elements," Bailey said, appearing on the Mythical Kitchen podcast. "It got leaked, nobody knew the full story and all that got leaked were these horrific scenes. It had been leaked that there's a trans character in the game. The scene comes out where [Abby] has got a golf club. It just turned into a nightmare online.
"They were looking into all of the active death threats that were coming in," Bailey continued. "Because it was constant. They threatening my parents, they were threatening my baby."

The leak of various cutscenes in April 2020 — several months before The Last of Us Part 2's official release — led franchise steward Neil Druckmann to say he had been left "heartbroken" at their impact after working for years on the game. Naughty Dog issued an official statement pleading with fans not to spread the spoilers further online but, predictably, such was the fan investment in The Last of Us Part 1's duo of Ellie and Joel that word of the latter's abrupt murder by Abby spread quickly across the internet.

"I knew it was going to get a reaction because Joel is beloved and he is an amazing character," Bailey noted. "I loved him. I knew that was coming. But because of the leaks, it was just a lot. Up until then I was very present online and I shared a lot of my sense online. I kind of backed off after that.

"The haters are very loud online," she concluded, "but there's a ton of people that love that game and still come up at cons to me, and are dressed as Abbie and say she changed their life and it's an amazing game. And it is, it's beautiful and the message of it is beautiful."
Despite all of that, Bailey went on to win Best Performance at The Game Awards 2020, while IGN's The Last of Us: Part 2 returned a perfect 10/10 score.

news.title: 《GTA 6》在 PC 上可能会玩得最好，但在控制器上玩效果会更好
news.summary: I cannot get over all the ways Rockstar has turned a controller into an immersion tool.

content.v: I hate to credit Sony's aggressive (and presumably very expensive) marketing campaign for GTA 6—you know, the one which appeared to have also plucked the ability for Xbox to even mention the game by name. That's something I'm still shocked was even a thing anyone was allowed to do.

So I won't credit it… mostly. We all already know that PC is going to get the best version of GTA 6 when it finally hits our desktops, whenever that might be. But I am going to agree with one part of the whole "Grand Theft Auto 6 plays best on PS5" shtick: the DualSense controller. It's so good that I fear those who reach for a mouse and keyboard will be missing out on some incredible immersion.
In control

I never expected a controller to actively add to my experience, but I also forgot just how many goodies Sony stuffed into this thing. Seriously, Rockstar has taken full advantage of everything the peripheral has to offer.

I've been weaving through traffic way more in GTA 6 thanks to a huge increase in general vehicle density and some criminally narrow roads that can cause some major bottlenecks. Flooring it all the way from A to B isn't quite as easy as it used to be, which is why I kind of love how you can use the adaptive triggers to comfortably maintain a steady cruising speed before clicking it all the way in as a way to floor it. It makes my speed feel just that little more deliberate, with that tactile feel for when I really want to amp up how fast I'm going.

But driving might actually be the least interesting way Rockstar has made full use of the controller. The parts that have gotten me more than anything are the small ways haptics have been implemented to strengthen story moments or make parts of Leonida feel even more alive.

The first time I really noticed the controller was back in the beginning of the game, when I'm instructed to go and pick Lucia up from prison. As I'm standing outside as Jason, watching her emerge from the gate, the controller starts thumping just a little bit. A heartbeat. I'm literally feeling Jason's heart racing as Lucia approaches. No dialogue, no internal monologue letting me know how nervous he is. It's such a small detail, but one that massively hammed up the moment for me.

My absolute favourite way it's been implemented, though? The clubs. The goddamn clubs. Leonida's sprawling nightlife is already impressive in isolation—Hitman's Berlin level was the last time I felt this enamoured with a videogame nightclub—but this is where Rockstar went all-in on the controller's haptic feedback. Step into a club and you'll immediately feel the bass pulsating through the controller.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dtUdUWw3haf9iirzZjNTF7-1920-80.png

It's not just the same, monorhythmic beat for every song though. The bass perfectly matches the song; those long, teeth-shaking booms cut with shorter, less intense thumps. I feel like I'm back in my first year of university trying to sleep while the nearby student nightclub blasts the same songs until 3am every damn Wednesday, the bass somehow reverberating across the campus and straight through my bedframe.

When I first set foot inside the Jack of Hearts club at the beginning of Chapter 3, I was practically stunlocked by how much more immersive being able to feel the bass through the controller was making the entire experience. Seriously, I cannot overstate just how much it sucks you into what's happening around you.

These are all things that I genuinely feel folks are going to miss out on with a simple mouse and keyboard. Sure, your aiming will be better. Yes, none of the things I've described above actually change anything about the gameplay. It'll still be the same GTA 6 no matter what you play with. But for all the ways Rockstar has managed to elevate the experience and the immersion I've been feeling just through something as small as the controller I'm holding? It at least deserves consideration for your go-to playthrough peripheral.

news.title: 《侠盗猎车手 6》发布当天《周四橄榄球之夜》的收视率是整个赛季最低的
news.summary: The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of

content.v: The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of the entire season so far for a TNF game, but the low ratings might not be due entirely to competition with GTA 6.

The data shows that 12.23 million people, on average, watched the November 19 matchup between the Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans on Prime Video. That was a 9% slide from the Week 11 Thursday Night Football matchup in 2025 featuring the New England Patriots and New York Jets.

Looking at week-over-week, the November 12 matchup this year between the Washington Commanders and New York Giants drew 16.27 million viewers , and was up 17% compared to the Week 10 matchup in 2025 featuring the Las Vegas Raiders and Denver Broncos.
Due to the poor ratings of the November 19 TNF game, the full-season average now for TNF games this season sank to 16.62 million on per game.

One expert told GameSpot that live sports like football probably won't be too heavily impacted by GTA 6 because people want to watch in real time. The low ratings for the November 19 matchup could be partially attributable to competition with GTA 6, but a likelier scenario is that people tuned out because it was a boring game in which the heavily favored Texans throttled the Colts by a score of 26-3.
The Texans were up 17-3 at the half, and the game only had nine more points total scored in the second half--all by the Texans. Not exactly thrilling stuff that people would stay glued to.

Ahead of GTA 6's launch, people also wondered how The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which released on November 20, might be impacted. It may have been, but the film still put up massive numbers at the box office that exceeded expectations.

GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027 , as rumored.
If you're just getting started, be sure to check out GameSpot's rundown of the five best things to do first and our guide for how to make money fast .

news.title: GTA 6 和 Red Dead Redemption 共享同一个宇宙的明确证据
news.summary: Here are the seven easter eggs in GTA 6 that prove Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto take place in the

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/red-dead-blog-1795529199286.jpg

From action movies to popular memes, there are dozens and dozens of Easter eggs and references to wider pop culture in GTA 6. But Rockstar has also slipped in more than a few nods to some of the studio’s previous games within Leonida. There’s a Manhunt-themed tattoo, for example, and a ludicrously convoluted secret that has already been unearthed involving a portal back to the days of Vice City. But one series is showing up more than others: Red Dead Redemption.

We’re still working our way through finding all of them, as is the rest of the internet, but so far we’ve found seven secrets that relate to the developer’s beloved Western games. From hats and guns to road names and license plates, here are seven Red Dead Easter eggs in GTA 6.
Valentine Drive
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124145128-1795534655949.jpg

If you’re looking for hidden details about Red Dead, the Western-themed Frontier Mini Golf course is a natural place to start. While none of the holes directly tell the tale of Red Dead Revolver, Red Dead Redemption, or its prequel—aside from squinting at hole four and seeing a snowy train wreck as a tangential nod to RDR2’s prologue—there are still things to find.

We’ll get on to who can be seen roaming it in a moment, but before you even set foot inside, an Easter egg can be found. That’s because the attraction itself is located on Valentine Drive, a reference to the first major town you explore in Chapter 1 of Red Dead Redemption 2’s story. This is the location where Arthur famously drinks a few too many beers, has a bit of a dance, and looks for his friend, Lenny. Sadly, alcohol doesn’t seem to be served at this Mini Golf, although there’s nothing stopping you from bringing your own six-pack in.
Tiny Arthur Morgan
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/gta-6-99-incredible-little-details-17-32-screenshot-1795534637517.png

Once you’re on the course, though, a little friend with a familiar face riding on his back may well walk up to you. A small chihuahua with a cowboy toy, dressed in remarkably similar clothing to what Red Dead Redemption 2 protagonist Arthur Morgan wore in many of the game’s trailers. Feel free to give the little guy a pet, too, and his gun-toting rider will look like he’s giving it a little “yeehaw”. Adorable.
Arthur’s Hat
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/red-dead-blog-1795534613357.jpg

Perhaps more life-sized Arthur Morgan Easter eggs are more your thing, though. Well, get yourself over to Port Gellhorn to get your hands on, and head in, one such thing. Follow the trail of signs and balloons to find a resident looking to get rid of any old tat. Hidden amongst it all, though, is a real treasure. No, not the cow-patterned Hawaiian shirt, but something that will make fans of Red Dead Redemption 2’s hearts flutter a little: a genuine cowboy hat. Not just any cowboy, either, but Arthur himself. The dark brown colour, complete with twisted rope around the rim, is unmistakable, and is now Jason or Lucia’s to wear whenever they like. An absolute bargain at $35, too.
Duke Arms
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124145822-1795534596884.jpg

As if we needed any further proof that the Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption stories take place in the same universe, the Duke Arms Company cements this. At any of Leonida’s Ammu-Nation stores, you can find weapons made by the same gun company that produced the Duke 1853 Navy Revolver in Red Dead Online. On the packaging found inside GTA 6’s gun stores, you can also spot 1853 written out in Roman numerals (MDCCCLIII) on the boxes. It just can’t be a coincidence.
Flaco Hern á ndez and Blackwater
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124150135-1795534554312.jpg

“The Cowboy’s Prayer is To Die Young” is a Wild West-set novel of which you can read a few pages in GTA 6. There are a few fun little details hidden within. First, a mention of Blackwater, the port city from Red Dead Redemption and its prequel, where John Marston chooses to build his ranch near to. But there’s also a familiar name to those who chose to fully engage with RDR2’s side activities.

Flaco Hernández was an infamous outlaw who you can meet during the 2018 game’s “The Noblest of Men, and a Woman” stranger mission. At the end of that story, you knock on his cabin by Cairn Lake and defeat him in a duel. The book in GTA 6 recounts all of these details, confirming that the events of Rockstar’s Western games are canon in Grand Theft Auto lore. There are many copies of the book to be found around Leonida, but I spotted one at the Grayson Motel towards the north of the map in Lummox County.
New Austin License Plates
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/new-austin-map-1795534526098.jpg

More locations from Red Dead here, as you may have spotted some vehicles roaming around Leonida that don’t sport license plates belonging to the “Goodtime State”. In fact, some of them hail from New Austin, the sandy state in Red Dead Redemption where the likes of Armadillo, Tumbleweed, and Thieves’ Landing can be found. Unfortunately, you can’t add one of these to your own car at a GTA 6 mod shop, but you can always jack someone else’s ride if you want to pretend you’re from the cowboy-adjacent state.
Rad Dad’s Redemption Tour
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/grand-theft-auto-vi-20261124153157-1795534499270.jpg

And finally, more of a fun wink to the camera than a full-on Easter egg, there’s a band playing live shows in Leonida that must be a fan of Rockstar’s western games. Get yourself over to the Three Sheets liquor store in the starting area of Key Lento to take a look at a poster for the Rad Dads’ show. They’re heading out on a redemption tour. Rad Dads Redemption. Red Dead Redemption. Get it? There’s not much more to say about this one than that, really.
And those are the Red Dead secrets that we’ve found so far in GTA 6. Did we miss any? Let us know in the comments.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

news.title: GTA 6 有一个秘密任务，感觉就像硬目标遇见了锯子
news.summary: In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6 , you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is

content.v: In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6 , you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is the deadliest game, as this secret mission will require cunning and sharp shooting to survive. It's Hard Target meets SAW, and the victor gets a pretty sizable stack of cash. Here's how you can be the most elusive of quarry.
Go to Hyde Island
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-2.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-10.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-11.jpg?w=636

Located north of Lummox County and the Moreau River, Hyde Island is where you can start this mission. All you have to do is land on the island, and after a few steps, a dart will hit you and knock you out.
Listen to your captor's speech
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-5.jpg?w=636

Now for the boring part. You'll wake up inside of a shipping container, with a fashionable explosive necklace locked in place. Once your captor finishes his rant, the game begins, and you'll want to move .
Run to the tent directly in front of you
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-6.jpg?w=636

You'll have 10 seconds to reach a tent in front of you, where you'll find a gun and a paltry two rounds for the sidearm. After the count is up, a hunter on a quad bike will show up, and he'll be gunning for you. To make things worse, he also has a dog with him that'll track you throughout the island. Don't engage him; he's heavily armored, and two bullets aren't nearly enough to stop him—besides, you'll need those rounds for his dog, Caesar. Sorry, animal lovers.
Search for more outposts
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-7.jpg?w=636

You can find more ammo, adrenaline, and a shotgun at nearby outposts. Each one is lit up, so be fast, be sneaky, and try not to get caught. The hunter is going to be tracking you constantly, even without his dog, and he has a sniper rifle that can take you out in just a few shots if he catches you.
Prepare for a showdown
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-1.jpg?w=636

Get as much ammo as you can, and choose your spot for the last stand. The hunter's dog will be a pest, so deal with it first. It's easy to spot, with a red light on its collar. Trees also make for good cover against the hunter, so once he's in range, start nailing him with shots to critical areas. Once he stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds and finish him off.
Collect your rewards

Once the hunter is down, search his body for the Island-Poacher FF-50 sniper rifle and ammo for it. Head west to the boathouse to reclaim your personal items and $15,000 in cash. Not a bad haul for a deadly night's work.
What happens if you fail?
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-Deadliest-Game-9.jpg?w=636

If the hunter does kill you, you'll lose a chunk of cash and wake up near one of your safehouses. The good news is you can retry the mission by heading back to Hyde Island, but the bad news is you'll have to listen to the hunter's speech again.

For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub. This is constantly updated, with walkthroughs on how to play GTA 6 on your phone , how to unlock hurricanes , and how to go to hell for a fight against Satan himself.

news.title: 《质量效应》编剧表示，“作为一名粉丝，我会对他们为 ME 宇宙中的 ME3 结局提出的解决方案感到满意”
news.summary: My personal solution would be playable elcor main character. Can't go wrong with that.

content.v: Spoilers for the end of Mass Effect 3 follow, naturally.

You know what? I didn't have many questions left at the end of Mass Effect 3. Joker was a robot now. His robot girlfriend was perhaps less of a robot? Shepard converted herself into a dotfile to make the Reapers chill out, and Buzz Aldrin's talents lie in areas other than voice acting.

I had plenty of questions when BioWare announced Mass Effect 5 was gonna be a thing though. Could you really write a Mass Effect story in the radically changed galaxy we were left with at the end of Shepard's adventure? Apparently, you could. In a recent AMA on Reddit (via IGN ), BioWare writer Cat Valente wrote that the now-cancelled Mass Effect sequel's team put a lot of work into handling ME3's endings "in a way that wouldn't piss everyone off, [or] at least not piss them off completely".

The goal, says Valente, was to write a continuation of Mass Effect's narrative that "wouldn't privilege any one kind of player over another". That tracks with what we've heard before: leaks have suggested ME5 was set to more or less wrap all the previous game's endings into one (Deus Ex: Invisible War style, hell yeah).

Of course, it'd have to do that while allowing BioWare "to actually write a coherent story going forward, within the limits of having to do it in a playable mainstream videogame and not a post-modern 3000 page novel", adds Valente. "Not for nothing, guys, but that's *kind of a tall fucking order*. Part of the reason it took so long and Andromeda was in Andromeda is that figuring out an elegant solution to that problem turns out to be *really hard*".

The sheer challenge of creating a coherent, satisfying follow-up to ME3 that took into account everyone's choices had Valente, at one point, "thinking *god, if I'd known when I finished ME3 that I'd be one of the people who had to find the mops and buckets to clean up that mess...*".

Nevertheless, she reckons the studio did eventually alight on a way of handling it that made sense. "Yes, there was an answer, yes, I know it, as least inasmuch as I know what it was when I was working there… We knew all the discourse on the endings, of course we did, and I do think as a fan I would have been happy with the solution (at least what it was when I left) if I booted up the game having had nothing to do with it".

And, well, that's that. We'll never know if the internet would have been satisfied or not (though I know where I'd put my money on that question), because EA killed the project and BioWare with it , and there's rarely a follow-up to an ending like that.

news.title: GTA 6 玩家正在将金钱故障优化到一英寸之内，以便在短短 10 分钟内赚取 100,000 美元
news.summary: We’ve already covered players using infinite money glitches to get rich quickly in GTA 6, but people are takin

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/24/vintage-vice-city-weapon-pattern-01-1795529184487.jpg

We’ve already covered players using infinite money glitches to get rich quickly in GTA 6 , but people are taking it to the next level. New money-making optimization strategies are seeing players become millionaires in a couple of hours, while still in the early game.
Instead of playing the game as intended and robbing stores, banks, and gang hideouts, some GTA 6 players are repeating the same actions over and over to generate money fast.
How to do the new GTA 6 money glitch

The new method sees players using vans and character swaps at a location in a town called Hamlet. In Hamlet, there’s an industrial area with a big warehouse outside of town, with a teddy bear van parked outside.

There are drugs inside the van outside as well as inside the warehouse itself. To do the glitch, you need to register two vans, turn up to the location, and have your partner call in a different personal vehicle while the player calls in one of the personal vans and takes the loot.

Stow the loot in the back of your personal vehicle, then drive the teddy van parked outside into the warehouse, parking it inside, on the right of the door, at which point tell your partner to wait in the car. The player then gets out and drives the teddy bear van parked inside (both of these vans are empty of loot at this point) and park this opposite the other van, so both vans have their back doors facing the shutter entrance.

Next, switch to your partner and exit the first teddy van before heading outside, where you switch back. Then ask your partner to drive the personal van loaded with all the loot. Using the partner menu, ask your partner to fence the loot, and watch them drive off to do so.

Once your partner has driven off, use the Scooter Bros app to call in the second personal van. After backing the van up to the warehouse, switch to the partner fencing the loot, before immediately switching back. This respawns both teddy bear vans and the loot inside, but it also keeps the two you moved earlier where you parked them inside and fills them with loot, essentially doubling the take.
According to one GTA 6 player who posted about this new method on Reddit , the technique earns you between $88,000-$100,000 in under 10 minutes.

Some of the replies to the Reddit post asked the OP when their in-game bank account limit will be raised, suggesting they’re still relatively early in the game. Later on, more lucrative robbery opportunities open up for players anyway, and you can pull off $100k jobs with way less hassle than this, and while having some actual fun whilst you’re at it.

The question is whether Rockstar patches early days money glitches like these out of GTA 6. GTA 6's first post-launch patch failed to take action, but I imagine it won't be long before Rockstar does something about this.

news.title: 我看了几个小时的 GTA 6 游戏内电视节目，它们绝对狂野
news.summary: Rockstar's satire has reached new levels with in-game cartoons like Barnyard Blue and the dark comedy The Tyro

content.v: Of all the things I expected of Grand Theft Auto 6, sitting there watching in-game TV for like… two hours was not on my list. Freshly preloaded and ready to go on my Xbox Series X right at 3am on the west coast, claiming to be in New Zealand, booting it up for the first time had me rubbing my hands like Birdman – I was ready to get in the thick of it in GTA 6. What could this new Vice City's criminal underworld make me do? Not much. Will I have to survive shootouts early on, and will I need to contend with the new wanted system in a car chase? Not really. Mostly because as soon as I got to Jason's home in the opening hour, I sat my ass down on his living room couch, flipped on Weazel News and couldn't believe what I was seeing.

In GTA 6, you can sit on the couch and flip through three TV channels of original in-universe programming – full-on TV shows made for the game, existing within the fiction of its world. You have Weazel News, the nutty right-wing parody that broadcasts news segments and TV series with the production value of something we'd see in our real world. Then there's the Telemundo spoof called Megamundo that shows Spanish-language soap operas / telenovelas, but with the absurdity cranked up several notches. Lastly, there's the Visit Leonida channel that's dedicated to advertising tourist attractions and businesses across this fictional rendition of Florida, satirizing modern economics and business.

And no, these are not channels with maybe a couple minutes' worth of gags to see once and move on from – these act as legit television programming, shows with multiple episodes that go on for six to eight minutes each. Why would I flip through my free Roku channels or be hit with choice paralysis on my own TV's built-in streaming apps when GTA 6 could rapid fire some of the wildest shit the series has done with shows you'd never see on real TV?

I'd get a kick out of Alan Wake 2's Koskela Brothers commercials or Max Payne's Adventures of Captain Baseball Bat Boy episodes, which aligned with Remedy's style and universe. But it's kind of astonishing that GTA 6's level of production value for in-game entertainment would rival or exceed cable TV – if someone was going to do it, though, it'd be Rockstar.

Weazel is by far the most intricate channel, weaving in anchored news segments and on-the-ground reporting that take ridiculous right-wing talking points and conspiracy theories to seed its own brand of misinformation across Leonida. In between these reports are legitimately produced TV shows to further clown on this type of extremist politics through shock humor.

Barnyard Blue is straight-up cop propaganda masked as a children's cartoon with an aggressive blonde child partnering with anthropomorphic animals "solving" crimes on a farm, clearly satirizing police brutality and abuse of power by law enforcement you see in the real world. One episode ends with the child monologuing the lesson, "Don't question authority silly! Respect the chain of command like your life depends on it, and one day, you'll be the law and can do, well, pretty much anything you like!"

Right Wing is an Adult Swim-style animated superhero series where the titular eagle-themed "hero" tries "saving America" from its "societal ills" – it highlights the projection and hypocrisy of modern conservative politics with regard to LGBTQ+, but done in such an over-the-top and comedic fashion that either has me cringing or cracking up. In one episode, a villain called "The Flamer" captures the President and has him tied up and in a ball gag. Right Wing gets word about the situation from inside a gay club and exclaims, "Repression builds character, dammit! Not on my watch!" He then busts into the Oval Office, confronting The Flamer with, "Get your beautifully manicured hands off the President!" In an attempt to save the President from being kissed by The Flamer, he dives in and ends up kissing The Flamer.

The Johnsons is another animated series made in the vein of Family Guy that centers around a family of… anthropomorphic (?)... penises… who try adjusting to a new community full of free-spirited neighbors, and highlights the absurdity of social conservatism. You'll see husband and wife Hugh and Wanda meet their new neighbors who are a couple they mistakenly think are inviting them to a sex party and end up at a very normal get-together in BDSM gear. "She shows me she loves me by stuffing my nuts into a little bird cage, but that's us. The important thing is remembering why you fell in love in the first place," the neighbors conclude. To which Hugh tells Wanda, "Oh honey, you know I'd let you rearrange my balls like origami anytime."

Then there's The Tyrone Show which is a mockumentary-style sitcom about Tyrone and his increasingly ridiculous, unhinged dating life in Vice City – it's meant to mock the modern dating scene in cities like Miami and takes cues from The Vince Staples show. With the slapstick, hostile nature, I'm still trying to work out whether its satire is problematic, hilarious, or mean-spirited, or all of those things in combination, and maybe that's the point? All I know is the acting performances are incredible and I can't look away, and maybe that's also the point.

Trying to gauge Rockstar-style satire and whether or not its commentary is poignant, that's something we'll probably be stewing on for a good long while. Regardless, there's no denying that this is the studio's biggest effort building out an in-world fiction. The Megamundo telenovelas got crazy twists that put those reruns of Cuna de Lobos in the background of my grandma's house to shame.

The Visit Leonida channel features PSAs from the state government to warn them about wildlife outbreaks and the governor's pretty fucked-up crusade against furries. Those are interstitials between hysterical ad spots for the likes of car detailing shops, restaurants, and lawyers that spoof on American commercials for genuine laugh-out-loud moments. Tourism stingers poke at glorifying gentrification, overindulgence, and ads that play on selling working-class people on faux lavish lifestyles. Of course, GTA's advantage is not having to abide by FCC regulations, and that it's a video game after all – you can mock your audience all you want.

Vice City being based on Miami, GTA 6 is sprinkled with Cuban culture and brushes right up on the line of stereotypes. One commercial rapidly fires off all the services immigrants may need – "Need a notarized affidavit for your cousin's immigration papers? Boom. And we got pin pan puns, too! (Aye coño!) A new ID and a set of 26-inch rims? Hit up 'I Know A Guy'" If you're from this part of the world, these jokes do play into something very familiar to us (and referencing a pin pan pun tells me someone Cuban definitely wrote this commercial).

As our GTA 6 reviewer Luke Reilly said , there are many, many distractions, most of which are great. In my early hours in Leonida, watching TV has been the greatest one yet, and it's going to be tough to top. So, if you have some downtime between missions, housework, errands, or heists, check out GTA 6's TV shows for the dark realization of how our world is a real messed-up place, but one where you may as well get some laughs out of it along the way.

content.v: Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals , and to celebrate, a new Lego set is on the way that lets you build the game's unofficial mascot, Jeff the Land Shark. While we regularly see Lego Marvel sets roll out, this is the first-ever Marvel Rivals kit, and it'll go on sale starting January 1, 2027, priced at $50. GameSpot can also exclusively reveal the first images of Jeff below, showing the completed build alongside his box art.

The 495-piece set captures the adorable strategist in all his glory, including his big eyes, toothy smile, huge tongue, and even his collar. This won't be a static figure either: once fully assembled, Jeff has a movable head, legs, tail, and fins that let builders recreate his joyful trot, swimming, and battle poses. For added touches, his collar includes his signature name tag, his tongue can be removed to close his mouth, and his fin can be detached so builders can replicate Jeff's Hide-and-Seek movement ability from the game.

"Jeff brings together everything players love about a breakout gaming character: an unforgettable silhouette, a personality you understand instantly, and the ability to turn any match into a story," Lego Marvel design lead Jesper C. Nielsen said in a press release. "We wanted this Lego model to capture both sides of him, from the lovable companion fans want beside their screen to the unpredictable strategist they meet in battle."

Meanwhile, Jeff and the rest of the Marvel Rivals roster are preparing to cap off an entire year of Avengers-centric events that have been building up to the game's big Avengers: Doomsday tie-in. Season 11.5 kicks off on December 11. Nightcrawler was recently added to the game, bringing mutant energy, swords, and teleportation strategies, and he'll soon be followed by Marvel's unique take on Dracula, who has spent the last few months hibernating and healing for the battles ahead.

news.title: 如何通过 Xbox 上的远程游戏在 PC 或手机上玩 GTA 6
news.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming , and Microsoft has also now confirmed sup

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming , and Microsoft has also now confirmed support for Remote Play on Xbox. This means you can play GTA 6 on your PC, smartphone, or a device like Xbox Rog Ally.
Remote Play is an Xbox service that lets you stream games from your Xbox Series X|S to a device you might already have, and it's easy to get working.
From your console, select Settings then Devices & connections then Remote features . From there, check the box for Enable remote features .
Xbox Remote Play also has a "test" feature so you can preview the experience in your home environment before going further.

From there, you can play GTA 6 from a mobile device by accessing the Xbox Remote Play website , selecting the console you want to connect to, and then the device. To play GTA 6 on your PC or Xbox Rog Ally, users can open the Xbox app for PC, click on their profile, then select Accessories & Remote Play and then select Remote Play to choose the device to play on.

Additionally, people have spotted that GTA 6's store page on the PlayStation Store now mentions that Remote Play is supported and that PlayStation 5 and PlayStation Portal owners can use cloud streaming if they have a Premium membership.

Right now, you need a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S to stream GTA 6, but some are dreaming of the day when you can simply stream the game to your PC or phone without any expensive hardware. That day may eventually come for GTA 6, as Take-Two's own CEO has said the rising cost of gaming hardware is not a good thing and that streaming games could be a big business very soon.

“If you believe in streaming, and to be clear, we really do, and I’m happy to put a timeline on it. I think we’ll be in commercial streaming mode within three years, and by commercial, I mean low latency," Strauss Zelnick said. "That can 10x the effective installed base. Now, it doesn’t mean we’re going to 10x our revenue–and we wouldn’t project that we would–but because obviously your avid consumers already had access to video game machines. But I do think it creates great opportunity for titles that are broadly desirable, even outside of core markets.”
GTA 6 is doing just fine without the potential expanded reach of streaming. After all, the game sold 32.5 million copies before launch and generated close to $4 billion in revenue by day one.

Even if GTA 6 doesn't add support for full streaming without a console, the game is expected to expand its reach in a major way in 2027 with an expected PC release. Beyond that, GTA 6 is reportedly going to add an online mode in 2027 as well, and it could be bigger than Fortnite .

news.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》周末一直在寻找 bug 和金币探索，现在发现 Sunder Armor 可能不起作用
news.summary: Lightning and sunder.

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever 's absolutely had me enthralled, as per my review (and about 220+ hours of my actual life), but that's not to say there aren't issues. Over the weekend and going on into this week, Blizzard's had to play whack-a-mole with both exploits and what appears to be a long-standing bug affecting one of the tanking classes' core mechanics.

First, those exploits—players discovered that lockboxes contained a sort of quantum loot, in that the actual roll of the lockboxes seemed tied to the player peeking inside of them, rather than what was inside regardless. If you turned off auto-loot, you can open a lockbox without actually pulling the loot into your bag. Then, if you sent that lockbox to another player via mail, they'd get something different.

Essentially, players could simply play a game of mass pass-the-parcel to ensure favorable lockbox results, further busting up the economy after the Blackmaw Hold drama earlier this month. That's since been hotfixed , simply disabling the mechanic, with a more elegant solution to come further down the road: "Today, we’re working on a proper fix that restores the ability to peek and partially loot lockboxes, and makes them otherwise work as intended."

Meanwhile, the Obsidian Sentinel in Uldaman was briefly rendered lootless. As spotted by WoWHead , players could hop into the dungeon and repeatedly rinse the boss to grab a cheeky 18 or so gold in 15 minutes by vendoring the loot as a max-level character.

While that's not really game-breaking (instance lockouts are limited to five per hour), if you had an organised group of level 60s all funnelling gold to the same guy—like, say, if you were a streamer with a dedicated fanbase that didn't mind wasting a quarter of an hour, or if you were a large-scale RMT operation—there's a bigger problem.
That lootless state turned out to be a band-aid, as Blizzard simply lowered the vendor costs later.

Perhaps the biggest hiccup over the past weekend, though, is the fact that Sunder Armor (and other armor-reducing effects like faerie fire) very well might just not do anything. I hopped in-game to test it on my warrior and saw no noticeable difference between Sunder Armor in both dungeons and the overworld while fighting lower level targets, though my testing capabilities were limited solo, since armor is affected by the level of whoever's attacking the target: And if I rock up to an on-level elite in a dungeon at 60, I tend to die before I can get a good sample.

Fortunately, I don't need to be too thorough. There's a lot more comprehensive math and log-testing on this github post : "Once an armor debuff goes on, players' and pets' hits barely move, same as the report says. About 5% of the armor drop actually shows up in the damage, and more stacks don't help." The evidence is all pretty convincing.

While those other exploits are annoying oopsies, arguably just a result of players—who find edge cases like water finds cracks—stress-testing the system? The Sunder Armor bug is sort of huge, since that's one of the protection warrior's main group utilities (aside from being a tanky meatshield). It still appears to be filling its primary role of threat generation, but: Yikes.
There's no mention of it in the hotfixes , but I'll update this article if one pops up in the coming days.
